$comment: The one source for colour, type and spacing in this repository. scripts/build-tokens.ts renders a CSS file per surface from this; those files are never hand-edited and tests/design.test.ts fails when one is stale. The example repository has its own, because it is a different product in a different repository. Direction: the learnwithparam house book system, light only, serif prose and sans furniture. Two tokens are local to this repository and say so in their use line.

bg-alt.use: card, a panel lifted off the paper

bg-inset.use: sunk: table headers, inset panels, the contents page

ink-muted.use: captions, labels, the run sheet part names

ink-faint.use: margin column numbers. Never on bg-inset, where it does not reach AA-large

accent.use: local to this repository: the one accent, on callout edges and diagram emphasis. Large sizes only

pass.use: house go: a check that passed

fail.use: house no: a check that failed

wait.use: house ask: waiting on a person

refuse.use: local to this repository: refused by policy, which here is a success and has no house equivalent

term-bg.use: terminal blocks on screen only. The print block flattens them to paper

contrast.$comment: Every pair a surface actually renders, with the level it must reach. The test computes the ratio rather than trusting the note beside the colour. A text or state colour absent from this list is one whose legibility nobody checked; a border is exempt through its role.

serif.value: "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif
serif.use: prose, which is read: body paragraphs, headings, ledes and callouts

sans.value: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
sans.use: working furniture, which is scanned: contents, tables, run sheet part names, click paths
